title: Admin Change Priority Scorer & Risk-Weighted Triage Runbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a lightweight, auditable priority scorer and runbook for non-bug admin & access management requests (RBAC changes, SSO/SAML onboarding, SCIM provisioning, org policy exceptions). The scorer should combine risk signals, business impact, compliance constraints, and operational cost to produce a numerical priority and a recommended handling path (self-serve, Solutions Eng review, security approval, or enterprise SLA queue). Deliverables: scoring rules, decision thresholds, mapping to routing flows, example triage playbook, and integration knobs for the intake endpoint and Console routing rules.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric documented and stored in Confluence with example requests
Priority score output schema defined and added to intake API contract
Runbook outlines 4 handling paths and decision thresholds
Console routing mapping (self-serve / SE / Security / Enterprise SLA) validated with product ops
Automated unit tests for scorer logic and a sandbox dataset for evaluation
Stakeholders (Support, Security, Solutions Eng) have reviewed and approved the thresholds
runbook_steps: Step 0: Intake receives request with standardized fields (org_size, requested_change, data_sensitivity, existing_role_template)
Step 1: Compute base risk score (0-100) using weighted factors: data_sensitivity, blast_radius, regulatory_domain, change_type
Step 2: Compute business-impact modifier (0.5-2.0) from org_tier and uptime_dependency
Step 3: Compute operational cost estimate (low/medium/high) and map to numeric cost factor
Step 4: Final priority = round(risk_score * business_modifier * cost_factor), assign band (P0-P3) using thresholds
Step 5: Emit routing recommendation and required approvals (e.g., Security Review Required)
Step 6: Attach suggested template response and required artifacts to ticket (audit logs, justification, stakeholder signoff)
decision_notes: We deliberately prefer a transparent, additive scoring model (weighted linear) over a black-box ML model to keep audits simple for enterprise customers and Security. Thresholds will be tuned from a labeled backlog and can be gated per-customer via org-level overrides. If an automated score hits the critical threshold, it must trigger a mandatory Security review and block auto-approval.
